sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activities" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "end_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("end_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "ends_next_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ends_next_day" IN (0, 1)), "duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL CHECK("duration_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1440), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "tracking_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_unit" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reminder_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("reminder_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_schedules" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "habit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES habits (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "interval_days" INTEGER NULL, "target_value" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("habit_id", "effective_from"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_records" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "habit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES habits (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NULL, "target_snapshot" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("habit_id", "date_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayer_records" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "prayer" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "performed_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("performed_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "jamaah" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("jamaah" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("prayer", "date_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "worship_items" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "tracking_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "target_value" REAL NULL, "show_on_today" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("show_on_today" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "worship_records" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worship_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("item_id", "date_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reflections" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reflection_answers" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reflection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reflections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "prompt" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("reflection_id", "prompt"));
